inputs: report kind: competitive (institution id) or index report (report_jobs / published_reports row, or a file under Reports/)
the report's printed numbers: saved analysis, paid snapshot, or rendered file
outputs: per printed fee: tie out / moved since report / no live row / source check fails
per derived number: printed vs recomputed
dropped rows by reason and a ties-out verdict
budget: deterministic, no paid calls; one market recompute per report
triggering_workflows: before a paid report link is sent
before a state or national report is published
a guard or takedown run touched institutions in a report's market
failure_behavior: Without the printed numbers or stored text the affected items are reported as unknown; the verdict is 'ties out' only with no critical or major findings.
approval_requirements: None to run (read-only). Sending a report or a quote stays with James.
abstain_when: the report's printed numbers are not available
the market fails readiness and no saved copy exists
stored text is missing for a fee (its source check is unknown)
a pass/fail is asked against an older statistics method
